dedupe_keys.name: geo rijkswaterstaat nl dams and flood defences datasets

description: geo.rijkswaterstaat.nl: dams and flood defences datasets is a collection of datasets listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geo.rijkswaterstaat.nl. Coverage: the area served by geo.rijkswaterstaat.nl. The listing groups 23 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about dams and flood defences; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Nationale Basisbestanden Primaire Waterkeringen; RWS legger - Lengteprofiel over regionale kering; RWS legger - Dwarsprofiel over regionale kering; RWS legger - Lengteprofiel over regionale kering - prepub. Formats seen: WFS, WMS, OGCFEAT, OTHER. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/deed.nl). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
